# OS-FINALQA: the File rows that need a long list, docs/qa/catalogue/file.md. The card is the large card of the random user (qanet_card: about 2000 files in 52 folders, generated by
# tools/qanet_card.py into <build>/sim/cards/qanet_card, never committed), found with --cards. Its /Projects holds thirteen listed folders (Song 01..08, Broken 09..11, Junk OG, Recover Me;
# "Not a project" holds no project file and is not listed), A-Z, folders first. A computer (the card pulled, `card copy`) adds two project folders whose long names differ only at the end, so the
# list has fifteen entries. One `snap` for QA-FIL-116; the goldens are keyed qa_file_list/qa_fil_NNN.

document
wait 20
card qanet_card
wait 20

card pull
card copy "Projects/Song 01" "Projects/Long project name 2024 final mix v2"
card copy "Projects/Song 01" "Projects/Long project name 2024 final mix v3"
card insert
wait 100

tap file
wait 1000
tap f2
wait 1000
# A-Z, folders first: Broken 09, Broken 10, Broken 11, Junk OG, the two long names, Recover Me, Song 01..08 — fifteen entries.
assert state screen=FILE sel=Broken_09

# QA-FIL-116 (OS-AUDIT-37, E-LOAD-08): a name longer than 32 characters is cut in the middle: its first 25 characters, a ~, its last 6, so two names that differ at the end are told apart
# (the cursor still holds the full name: sel= of the long rows shows it whole).
snap qa_fil_116
tap down 4
assert state sel=Long_project_name_2024_final_mix_v2
tap down
assert state sel=Long_project_name_2024_final_mix_v3
tap up 5

# QA-FIL-002 (OS-SHIFTROW): Shift + F1..F5 jump the cursor to 0/4, 1/4, 2/4, 3/4 of the list and to its last entry (15 entries: 0, 3, 7, 11, 14); nothing is opened.
tap down 2
press shift
tap f1
release shift
assert state sel=Broken_09
press shift
tap f2
release shift
assert state sel=Junk_OG
press shift
tap f3
release shift
assert state sel=Song_01
press shift
tap f4
release shift
assert state sel=Song_05
press shift
tap f5
release shift
assert state sel=Song_08
assert state screen=FILE
